data.creative: Boy who had warts burned off 7 times shows the bottle · 1436628610780416
data.hook: Our son had warts on his feet, his knees, his hands.
data.desire: My kid wart-free without burning or pain.
data.angle: A boy tells how burning failed seven times and he was embarrassed at school, then shows the bottle that worked.
data.belief_shift: from burning them off is the only option and it doesn't work → to a little bottle at home cleared them with no pain (claim)
data.script_structure: Parent intro over foot photo → boy: burned off 7 times, nothing happened, embarrassed at school → shows bottle and applicator → lost warts on feet, hands → dad: no burning no pain, unbelievable → VO: works on all wart types → Aussie mums montage, 1-2 weeks, kids love it → 90-day guarantee → review screenshots → CTA
data.mechanism_reveal: None explained; 'a little bit of that gets it off' (claim).
data.proof: Boy testimonial with after-photo of his sole (15-18s); dad endorsement (22-26s); 3D skin animation (27-30s); 'thousands of Aussie mums' with montage (31-40s); 90-day guarantee (41-45s); review screenshots 'thousands of 5-star reviews' (45-49s).
data.cta: Check out H-Warts Formula today and help your kids be wart-free. Offer: 90-day money-back guarantee.
data.why_it_works: Interpretation of execution, not measured performance: A child naming seven failed burnings and school embarrassment is a strong failed-effort story told by the person who lived it. The second half stacks crowd, guarantee and reviews so the single story feels typical.
data.transferable_move: Let a child or end user count how many times the old method failed and how it felt socially, then cut to a montage and review screenshots to show it is common. Soften: speak of comfort and confidence, not wart removal. Do not copy 'thousands of mums say' without data.
data.opening_visual: Inset photo of a child's sole covered in warts against a white wall; caption 'Our son had warts on his feet'.
data.transition_to_product: At about 10.5s the boy holds up the bottle and applicator: 'It's the little bottle right here'.
data.proof_placement: After-photo follows the boy's result line; dad follows the boy; montage, guarantee and reviews follow the VO product claim, right before CTA.
